title: Agenda Result Toast
description: When an agenda vote finishes, every seat (the voters included, and spectators) gets one corner toast: the agenda, the winning outcome or the elected player/planet, the vote totals, a tie or a silent table decided by the speaker, and whether a law enters play or a directive is resolved. The real app fed by a mocked game; the toast reads the engine's public agenda_log in the state.

shots.heading: For wins (a law)
shots.caption: Anti-Intellectual Revolution: For wins, votes For 9 · Against 4, the law enters play.

shots.heading: Against wins (a directive)
shots.caption: Economic Equality: Against wins, votes Against 7 · For 3, directive resolved.

shots.heading: An election
shots.caption: Minister of Peace elects the viewer, who voted on it: the toast still shows for them. Elected players are named, planets and objectives by their printed names.

shots.heading: A tie
shots.caption: 4 to 4: the speaker decided, and the toast says so with the tied totals.

shots.heading: Nobody voted
shots.caption: No votes cast: the speaker decided.

shots.heading: Phone: For wins
shots.caption: At 390 px the toast wraps inside the corner box like the invasion results.

shots.heading: Phone: election
shots.caption: The election result on a phone.

notes.title: Where it comes from
notes.text: The engine appends a display-only record to state.agenda_log when a vote closes (after a Deadly Plot discard is known, before the agenda's effect is asked), and when Committee Formation elects a player without a vote. No rule reads it; it is skipped from the JSON while empty, and decision records and option ids are unchanged.

notes.title: Once, and never history
notes.text: Like exploration results, records present when the game loads or that reappear after undo/redo (a new history generation) never toast, and a later state with the same log does not toast again. The Toasts mute silences it.

notes.title: Hidden information
notes.text: The record is written only once the outcome is decided, so votes in progress are never shown early.
